dialogues.speaker: Nakano
dialogues.text: Yes. I enjoy watching this ocean and the sunshine every day.

dialogues.speaker: Nakano
dialogues.text: You're still young, so you probably don't know yet. The scenery you'll see in your 40s won't really be that much different from the stuff you're seeing in your 20s.

dialogues.speaker: Nakano
dialogues.text: Seeing how the sun rises from the east, sets in the west, and how the tides flow this way and that, I feel like I can understand the Eternity that the Almighty Shogun is pursuing...
